# Registrations are the game's roster (spec 02 §4 "During a game", §6, §8).
config guest=1
coin home 04000007 player=7
coin away 04000003 player=3
add away 4
coin home 04AAAAAA
start official
expect written game_started,player_joined,player_joined,player_joined,player_joined
expect roster home=7,?04AAAAAA away=3,4

# Changes during the game are game events.
assign 04AAAAAA 12
expect written player_assigned
expect roster home=7,12 away=3,4
remove away 2
expect written player_left
expect roster home=7,12 away=3,_

# A player who leaves stays in the game until replaced.
button home
expect written none
expect roster home=7,12 away=3,_
coin home 04000005 player=5            # rule 4: both left, the side is replaced
expect written player_left,player_left,player_joined
expect roster home=5,_ away=3,_

# A player moving sides mid-game.
coin away 04000055 player=5
expect written player_left,player_joined
expect roster home=_,_ away=3,5

# Game end: the coins are ejected and the one-game registrations end; the roster stays.
sensor home_goal
sensor home_goal
sensor home_goal
sensor home_goal
sensor home_goal
expect winner away
expect eject home,away                 # 5's first coin is still in the home acceptor
expect regs home=_,_ away=_,_
expect roster home=_,_ away=3,5
ejected home                           # the acceptors report the eject
ejected away
expect regs home=_,_ away=_,_

# Stale players are not in the next game.
wait 10s
coin home 04000007 player=7
coin away 04000003 player=3
coin away 04000009 player=9
button away
start official
expect regs home=7,_ away=_,_
expect roster home=7,_ away=_,_
